structure: Part 7 read, in full and at the tests repo's main (c433e6b), the 9 specs under tests/animals/e2e/features/address-book: addresses-add-handshake (363 lines; three tests looped over the five party pickers, eight single tests and a compose-only country-list test looped over three pickers), addresses-picker (298 lines; six picker tests and a four-test country search block), addresses-edit (158 lines, 5 tests), addresses-copied (201 lines, 4 tests), addresses-same-as (152 lines, 3 tests), addresses-read-only (89 lines; four tests looped over the five pickers and a 404 test looped over two retired paths), addresses-submit-freeze (107 lines, 2 tests), address-book-navigation (161 lines, 6 tests) and transporter-added-via-address-book (66 lines, 2 tests). It also read every support file the partition named: page-objects/animals/{addresses-page, party-picker-page, party-edit-page, permanent-address-page, transporter-page, transporter-add-page}.ts, page-objects/shared/{party-edit-form, address-picker-results, base-page}.ts, page-objects/ins/address-book/{add-page, form-page, shared-form-fields, address-type-page, url-with-return, list-page}.ts, domain/shared/constants/{address-types, journey-party-names, test-record-names}.ts, domain/ins/constants/{address-book-journey, address-book-types, address-form, trader-address, address-details}.ts, flows/shared/address-book-seed.ts, flows/animals/journey.ts, fixtures/ui.ts, utils/{address-book-cleanup, roles-options-assertions}.ts and bin/reset-e2e-address-book.ts; and, for verbatim copy, domain/animals/constants/consignment-addresses-page.ts, domain/ins/constants/transporter-types.ts and the picker and edit page slugs in page-objects/animals/index.ts. The earlier extract's contact-address page and branch-address role are gone from the repo since it was written (the contact address page object, its hand-off tests and the BRANCH_ADDRESS role were removed, and the consignment/contact/select path is now proven to 404), so the claims that described them are not kept. Covered: the add hand-off from each of the five party pickers to the INS frontend's /address-book/add and back (Save and select, Save and return to address page, Cancel and return to hub, Back, the banner's lifetime, the page's title, heading, caption, strip, sections, labels and autocomplete, the country select, the Consignee picker's roles question, and validation); the Consignment addresses page's party sections and their Add, Change, Edit details and Same as controls; each picker's role filter, page size of eight, results sentence, Selected address restatement, row layout, View link, search by name, by part of an address and by a country's name, and its no-matches message; the edit form; copied-not-linked, soft delete and invalid-copy behaviour on drafts; submit-freeze and amendment; cross-service navigation and Back with a return; a transporter created in the address book reaching the journey; the support code's cleanup and reset rules; and gaps where the constants or page objects name things no test in the slice asserts.
